entries.name: deepep-declared-toolchain-paths
entries.rationale: Persist immutable CUDA, NCCL, NVCC, and NVSHMEM paths only for the hermetic Nix package variant.
entries.removal_condition: Upstream supports declared runtime toolchain roots without build-path leakage.

entries.name: deepep-deterministic-version
entries.rationale: Bind wheel metadata to the full declared upstream revision without depending on a mutable Git checkout.
entries.removal_condition: Upstream accepts an immutable source revision as a supported PEP 440 local-version input.

entries.name: deepep-gin-attestation
entries.rationale: Expose whether an ElasticBuffer obtained NCCL Gin resources so qualification can attest the transport positively.
entries.removal_condition: Upstream exposes an equivalent stable backend-capability query.

entries.name: deepep-runtime-jit-cache
entries.rationale: Fail closed on a runtime JIT cache miss when a signed prewarmed cache is mounted read-only.
entries.removal_condition: Upstream provides an equivalent read-only or compile-forbidden JIT mode.
